name: halo
description: 2D · dark background, large phone with an accent-coloured glow (bleeds off the bottom), headline with one accent word.
design_notes: Health/wellness dark theme. Near-black background with a faint tint of the main colour. Centered bold white headline with one accent word. The phone is large, bleeds off the bottom edge, and has a glow in the accent colour radiating around its outline (inner glow feel). Clean, sharp hierarchy; no decorative clutter.
